mapper.insert: INSERT INTO login_code (member_id, challenge, code_hash, expires_at) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{challenge}, #{codeHash}, NOW() + INTERVAL 5 MINUTE)
mapper.select: SELECT id, member_id, challenge, code_hash, attempts FROM login_code WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL 1 MINUTE AND attempts < 5
SELECT id, member_id, challenge, code_hash, attempts FROM login_code WHERE challenge = #{challenge} AND expires_at > NOW() AND attempts < 5
